svg.title: Smart Cities SIG Approach: From Municipal Needs to Interoperable Solutions
svg.desc: The four stages of the Smart Cities SIG methodology: Operational Meaning, Semantic Capabilities, Standards and Ecosystem Mapping (split into standards organizations and open source), and Smart Data Models Realization (consolidated Smart Data Models and Smart City Profiles), followed by Proof of Concept Validation, with feedback from Stage 4 to Stage 3 and from validation back to Stage 1.
svg.text: Smart Cities SIG Approach: From Municipal Needs to Interoperable Solutions
Map municipal needs to existing standards,
structures that can be adopted by
The Smart Cities SIG transforms real municipal challenges into validated, standards-based,
reusable interoperability profiles that can be adopted by cities worldwide.
